lots.what_it_is: Binder sleeve pages of VFL cards: about 2 pages of 1990 Stimorol (red border, 'Legend' cards such as Keith Greig), about 3 pages of 1991 Stimorol (dated '1991' footer, incl North Melbourne and Sydney team cards), a page of late-1970s Scanlens (John Murphy, Nicholls, Pagan, Gordon Casey), a page of 1960s Scanlens TV-screen frame cards, and a page of 1960s Scanlens die-cut stand-up cards (Kevin Neale #32, Neil Ferguson #12, Ian Stewart #30, Gary Lazarus #7, Ricky Watt #23, Tom Allison #36, Noel Teasdale #43, Roger Dean, Mike Perry). More die-cuts are tucked behind the TV-frame cards.
lots.key_photo_findings: Read the die-cut numbers in photo 9: Allison is #36, Teasdale #43, Lazarus #7, which do NOT match the 1966 Scanlens numbering (Allison #35, Teasdale #12, Lazarus #64), so these are a different 1960s die-cut issue (year unconfirmed, possibly 1968). The researcher's 'Ferry' is Mike Perry. Photo 8: nine TV-frame cards with more die-cut cards stuffed behind them in the same pockets. Photos 2-3 show 1990 Stimorol design, 4-6 show 1991 Stimorol. A 1991 Wayne Carey rookie was not seen.
lots.condition: Die-cuts have rough, uneven cut edges and some surface wear; TV-frame cards have rounded, worn corners. Stimorol cards look clean. Several cards are double-stacked in pockets; backs not seen.
